doctrine: Lab receipts are EVIDENCE: never re-measured here, never invented.
A digest of a file that is not shipped proves nothing to a reader without it -- every row records contained_in_evidence_commit.
Three separate columns, never inferred from one another: model-legal window, machine-qualified window, episode-policy cap.
APPEND-ONLY. Every receipt-producing commit bumps manifest_version and appends its rows; rows are never rewritten in place.

admission_unenforced.ltx25_video: admission NOT enforced, and after the G8 solo smoke that is a DELIBERATE statement rather than a gap waiting to be filled. The smoke ran 2026-08-19 on the Sage-free LTX boot, twice (the lab's own 832x480 still and a real OTR 1472x832 scene still); both passed -- 97 frames exact, 832x480 probed, silence proved by ffprobe on the emitted file, no audio stream. BOTH RUNS MEASURED THE SAME PEAK: 16152 MiB by the adapter's 0.1s VramPeakProbe, with an independent 0.5s nvidia-smi sampler corroborating at 15848 MiB, on a 16303 MiB card. THAT IS 1324 MiB OVER THE LAB'S 14.48 GiB AND 1304 MiB OVER THE 14.5 GiB CLAMP -- about 99% of the card, leaving ~150 MiB of headroom. It is the documented family failure mode: in-pipeline peaks read higher than isolation probes, exactly as the sibling LTX lane breached at 14,716 MB after passing its own bench. So there is no QUALIFIED cost row here and no envelope key, nothing refuses an over-budget plan on this lane, and its receipts must not imply one. The recipe was NOT touched in response (operator: a wrong value is a finding to report, not a knob to turn), and the exact-16:9 rung the 2026-07-26 arc judgment would prefer, 1024x576, is 1.48x these pixels -- so this measurement supports the lab's OOM rejection of it. Whether this lane is fit for production at ~150 MiB of margin is an OPERATOR decision, not a driver one.

admission_unenforced.ltx25_foley_plus: admission NOT enforced, and on this lane that statement is STRONGER than its parent's rather than inherited from it. ltx25_foley_plus renders the IDENTICAL picture to ltx25_video -- same locked Q3 two-stage recipe, same 97-frame rung, same four weights -- so it starts from the same measured position: the G8 solo smoke measured that graph at 16152 MiB in-pipeline on a 16303 MiB card, about 99% of the card and roughly 1.3 GiB over the 14.5 GiB clamp, which is why there is no QUALIFIED cost row or envelope key for either lane and nothing refuses an over-budget plan on them. WHAT THIS LANE ADDS, and why its decode is a SECOND graph: keeping the model's audio needs LTXVAudioVAEDecode, and wiring it into the render graph would make the 348 MiB audio VAE a second remaining consumer, so free_after_use could no longer drop it before sampling and the sampling peak would rise by that much against ~150 MiB of headroom. The decode therefore runs only AFTER reclaim_idle_models has torn the render graph down, and the adapter logs its own decode_peak_mb on every beat so the second pass is measured rather than assumed. NOTHING HERE IS QUALIFIED YET. As of 2026-08-26 this lane has never rendered: no live leg, no measured decode_peak_mb, and the stage-2 foley QUALITY is an open assumption -- the lab's golden foley recipe is single-stage and this lane harvests the REFINED audio latent, which nobody has heard. Whether either LTX 2.5 lane is fit for production at ~150 MiB of margin remains an OPERATOR decision, not a driver one.

LANE 9's marker leg, and the FIRST vram_peak_mb this adapter has ever produced. Both of its render paths were probe-less until this lane: `render_clip` gained a VramPeakProbe earlier but `_render_clip_hq` -- the path the installed dev-family unet actually routes to -- had none, and `_clip_from_raw` dropped five of the seven receipt fields besides. render_driver substitutes `_mc.vram_used_mb()` when the peak is absent, so this leg would have reported 4,124 MB: a 3.9x UNDERSTATEMENT of the real peak, shaped exactly like a peak. That is the L10 PROVENANCE rule with a number attached. NOTE THE SURFACES (L7): 15,916 MB absolute is OVER the 14.5 GiB working ceiling and 13,313 MB net is under it. The cost-row surface is NET by the 2026-08-11 ruling; neither figure is quotable without naming which. This is the most expensive LTX 2.3 lane by net, which is what the `high` marker states.

otr_side_legs.note: LANE 9 LEG 1 -- S8b-14 answered at its ROOT. Every clip stamps `+prequalification[min_decode_frames=9]`, so no row here can be mistaken for a production leg, and `seeds_cost_row` is FALSE for the same reason: these are DECODE-BAND measurements, not envelope rows. THE RESULT: the band is OPEN at the declared 1024x576. f121 and f137 -- the exact pair that raises the wrapper's tensor 256-vs-128 (dim 1) mismatch at 1472x832 -- both decode clean here, as does f9, the ladder's bottom rung. So the 169 decode floor is CANVAS-DEPENDENT: real at 1472x832, absent at 1024x576. The floor moved to 9 and the contract became the honest 8n+1 `min_frames=9, quantum=8`. CROSS-CHECK: the f49 sweep clip is BYTE-IDENTICAL (sha256 50e0bb305506faa3de77234ae8c794d5ff2c338e083dab86f184dc3395b5984c) to the post-change production smoke that asked for 50 frames on a boot with no consent act at all -- so the env-forced floor and the shipped default render the same bytes, and the sweep measured the real thing.
